messages:
Marta: quick check — can owners confirm the deprecation timeline for the v2 /embed and /generate endpoints? trying to lock the customer comms schedule this week.
Eli: /generate v2 is on the calendar to start traffic migration Mon 2026-06-15. can hold if infra needs more time. current plan: canary -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days.
Sam: noted. SDK teams need one more day to ship the headers fix (see PR #4427). if that lands by EOD Friday we can proceed. @Priya is tracking SDK backcompat.
Priya: I have the PR green but a couple tests flaked on mac builders. I’ll bubble a hotfix first thing tomorrow; ETA 11:00 PT. tagging @Grace for docs / migration note.
Grace: will prep a short migration note and changelog blurb today. can we include the minimal example with the new header? e.g.,
```
client = Redwood(api_version="v2")
resp = client.generate("...", headers={"x-rw-compat":"v1-fallback"})
```

Alex: on model side, if runtime falls back we’ll reject older payloads that use legacy param `temperatureScale` — sending a compatibility shim would be needed. is that acceptable? fyi that shim costs ~5% latency.
Eli: prefer not to add shim in runtime unless absolutely needed. we can instead map legacy params in the gateway layer for a 2-week window and then remove.
Marta: so gateway mapping for 2 weeks is the agreed path? need owners to ack so PM can ship comms.
Sam: ack for gateway mapping. will add a short handler: map `temperatureScale` -> `temperature` and log a telemetry flag `legacy_param_seen`.
Priya: SDK will read `legacy_param_seen` and surface a warning in dev logs. good plan.
Eli: deploy-bot: scheduling canary for /generate-v2 on infra-hosts: gpu-pool-a on Mon 06:00 PT. please confirm slot availability.
deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: /generate-v2 -> gpu-pool-a at 2026-06-15T13:00:00Z (canary). Slots reserved: 3. Notify @eng-sre if rollback triggers.
Marta: perfect. any blockers we need to call out now?
Alex: one dependency — new quantized artifact needs a regenerate on the private pipeline. I expect the artifact by Friday 18:00 PT. if that slips, we should delay the canary by 24h.
Sam: noted. leaving a buffer in the rollout plan for +24h.
Priya: CI flakiness root cause is tracked in ticket ENG-9210; I'm posting a checklist in that ticket. pinging @Eli if you want me to attach SDK smoke tests to the canary job.
Eli: yes please. attach SDK smoke tests to canary. quick command for the canary job config:
```yaml
canary:
  smoke_tests:
    - sdk-smoke
    - api-contract
  rollback_on:
    - 5xx_rate>0.5%
```

Grace: docs + migration note will reference the schema change and the gateway mapping window. will push to docs branch `release/v2-migration` and open a PR.
Marta: thanks all — summary for comms: canary Mon 6/15, gateway mapping 2 weeks, SDK patch by Fri morning, artifact by Fri evening (watch ENG-9210), docs branch open. I’ll send a draft comms to the customers channel after PRs are green. :thumbsup:
Sam: pinging reviewers on PR #4427 — reviewers: @alex @marta. if anyone can spare a review today it would help.
Priya: I can review once the hotfix build passes (ETA 11:00). staging artifacts will be at `s3://redwood-artifacts/v2/generated/`.
Eli: last call: if any team needs an extra rollback window or a hard freeze window for releases, reply here now.
Alex: no freeze needed from infra side.
Marta: done — closing the loop. will post an ops checklist update tomorrow morning. thanks everyone! :rocket:
